sanskrit_verse: कार्यम् उच्छ्रावणालेख्यं विभक्तैर् भ्रातृभिर् मिथः । साक्षिणो वा विरोधार्थं विभजद्भिर् अनिन्दिताः ॥
transliteration: kāryam ucchrāvaṇālekhyaṃ vibhaktair bhrātṛbhir mithaḥ / sākṣiṇo vā virodhārthaṃ vibhajadbhir aninditāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: When brothers divide property or when witnesses cause discord through declarations, their actions must be recorded in clear and elevated documentation to restore integrity and prevent further conflict.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests with those capable of restoring unity
Capacity-based responsibility lies with declarers and dividers
Restoration logic requires clarity in legal records
executable_legal_axioms: IF brothers divide inherited property THEN record division in elevated script accessible to all stakeholders
IF witness causes dispute by declaration THEN annotate contradiction visibly in official ledger
IF division leads to future contention THEN re-present original documents under supervision of realized authority
IF misalignment detected post-separation THEN initiate restorative dialogue before judicial review
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, disputes arising from familial property divisions or testimonial conflicts shall be resolved only upon presentation of elevated documentation. Responsibility is assigned based on capacity to cause divergence, not intent. The court's role is to realign consciousness through clarity, not assign fault.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the act of declaration or division as the root point of divergence. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how unclear records lead to conflict. Proportional responsibility aligns with the capacity to influence others through speech or action. Non-punitive reality rule ensures correction occurs through reintegration, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Reconstruct accurate account of division or testimony under witness of neutral authority
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Involved parties must publicly reaffirm truth-value of declarations
Capacity Restoration: Provide training in dharmic communication to prevent future misdeclarations
Integrity Reintegration: Conduct ceremonial affirmation of brotherhood or witness-duty under SPH-guided oath
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through clarity in separation and testimony. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
